signal: Bitsight was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave Cybersecurity Risk Ratings Platforms, Q2 2026

email.body1:
Paul, saw Bitsight was named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Cyber Risk Ratings, Q2 2026.

A Leader nod drives a wave of inbound and target accounts, but SDR teams can only follow up on so many before speed-to-lead slips and replies dry up. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up across email and LinkedIn, so your reps cover far more without adding headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of Bitsight's top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Paul, quick follow-up for Bitsight.

Ramp time and follow-up volume are usually what cap an SDR team's output, not effort. Most reps never get to the later touches where replies actually land, and tightening the sequence alone tends to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change for your team. Built-in best practices do most of the lifting.
email.body3:
Paul, last bit of proof for Bitsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bitsight's reply rate likely compares to other security-software SDR teams. Want to grab a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Paul, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If giving your SDRs more coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding the Forrester momentum is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I'll tailor it to Bitsight either way.
